title: Bread
content:
# Bread

Type: Food | Internal ID: Bread | Source: Stone oven | Usage: Crafting, Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Bread dough x1 | Max Health: 23 | Max Stamina: 70 | Duration: 25m | Healing: 2 hp/tick

# Introduction

Bread is a Plains-tier food.

## Recipe

2 Bread doughs are produced in a Food preparation table with:
• 10 Barley flour
Bread is produced by baking Bread dough in a Stone oven for 50 seconds. If left in the oven for 100 seconds, it will burn and turn into Coal.

#### Bread dough

• Uncooked fish n' bread

#### Bread

• Plains pie picnic

## Notes

• Bread provides the second-highest stamina gain in the Plains at 70, second to Blood pudding at 75.

Categorias: Food, Materials
